title: A unified approach for testing in Hilbert spaces on incomplete data
summary: We consider statistical testing on the basis of incomplete observations with values in a separable Hilbert space, where the dimension is possibly large or even infinite. The general Hilbert space setting allows various data types as they arise in modern applications, in particular high dimensional and functional data. Possible Hilbert space testing problems are goodness-of-fit, symmetry, homogeneity and independence.
